answer.rationale: p99 latency is 5x target and isolated to primary region during peak settlement traffic. Rollback is blocked by mandatory security patch. Regional failover has proven success (memory_b2: clean traffic shift, latency recovery within minutes). This preserves the security patch while immediately relieving write path pressure. Read replica routing (memory_b5) addresses read load but primary issue is write latency. Circuit breakers (memory_b4) mitigate dependency failures but don't address primary degradation. Capacity addition (memory_b3) is slower than failover for acute regional degradation. Failover is the highest-confidence move that maintains customer writes and compliance requirements simultaneously.
